tax_litigation.status: The assessment was completed under Section 143(3), wherein the deduction claimed under Section 43B was allowed. However, the assessment order was received with a demand arising on account of disallowance of purchases from one of the parties and partial disallowance of R&D expenses. An appeal has been filed before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)], and the matter is currently pending, with the hearing date awaited.

tax_litigation.status: The Company received the CIT(A) order dated May 1, 2026, and filed an appeal before the ITAT on June 26, 2026. The hearing date is awaited. Subsequently, an order under Section 154 dated July 7, 2026, was received, making an additional disallowance of ₹1.72 lakh and raising a tax demand of ₹126 lakh. The Company is in the process of filing an appeal before the CIT(A) and a rectification application under Section 154 with the DCIT, as the Assessing Officer has not allowed the deduction under Section 80G amounting to ₹86 lakh.
